          Table "public.measurements_def"
 Column  |  Type   | Collation | Nullable | Default 
---------+---------+-----------+----------+---------

 val     | integer |           |          | 42
Partition of: measurements DEFAULT

    "measurements_def_pkey" PRIMARY KEY, btree (id, logdate)
